label: original-phase mid positions: f/s/z/n/l/j after an i/a/w/0/n-rich prefix
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase, almost always at steps 3-6 (t=4 peaks; nothing at t=0-1, at <DEL>, or in the copy phase). Within that window it behaves like a conjunction of the current input token and the preceding prefix. Current tokens f (7x lift), s, z, n, l, j drive it, and a/b/digits rarely do. The prefix contains tokens such as i (strongest, as prev or prev2 token), a, w, 0, n, m, o, x, v. The largest activations look like w/x/a i i [f]: f or s right after a prefix full of i. First occurrences of a token are favored (in_first 1.6x). The predicate is a coarse approximation of what looks like a graded additive token-by-context score. Dev F1 is about 0.38 (precision 0.31, recall 0.52, mass recall 0.62). The step window alone covers 97% of mass but has 4% precision. Many low-magnitude activations happen on other tokens or contexts, and many matching contexts stay below threshold.
